message: I recently stumbled upon a great resource about home fires, and it got me thinking about our family group chat during those moments. It’s not just about having a plan; it’s about knowing how to communicate and support each other when it counts. This info helps us understand what to do and how to stay connected, even in a tough situation. Have you and your family ever talked about your fire safety plan? What tips do you have to keep the conversation light but effective?
